rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for saying that a job, plan, or thing includes something.

example.english: This job can involve meeting clients.
example.traditional: 呢份工作包括同客人開會。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 baau1 kut3 tung4 haak3 jan4 hoi1 wui6

rows.traditional: 拉埋 A 一齊 V
rows.jyutping: laai1 maai4 A jat1 cai4 V
rows.note: Use this when someone actively brings A into an activity, rather than A choosing to participate.

example.english: We involve Ming by bringing him in to do homework with us.
example.traditional: 我哋拉埋阿明一齊做功課。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 laai1 maai4 aa3 ming4 jat1 cai4 zou6 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when a person participates in or engages with an activity or community.

example.english: They often involve themselves in community activities.
example.traditional: 佢哋成日參與社區活動。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 caam1 jyu6 se5 keoi1 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when one fact or consequence logically or naturally implies another.

example.english: This decision may involve us having to start over.
example.traditional: 呢個決定意味住我哋要重新開始。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ji3 mei6 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2
